title: Use a matched counterfactual operation to distinguish certification from yield
statement: On the same60,000-call bank/final bath, optimized six-state guard acceptance is about35.08percent versus about1.09percent for the old coarse-net Hedge distribution. Ordinary SLSQP yields the SAME rational candidate/performance; Nelder-Mead is about34.60percent. The inherited1/128 correctness is accepted-subnormalized, not normalized rare-success fidelity. The300 sampled continuations are counterfactual from one post-training bath, not300 sequential reset deployments.

assumptions: Exact empirical optimality is not future physical fidelity or an acquired stationarity promise. The generic four-variable resultant template is not a completed generic solver implementation; finite SOS successes do not prove a fast worst-case oracle. Candidate-dependent runtime needs source-clock padding/isolation. The60,000-call retained-bank comparison is counterfactual from one actual final bath, not repeated sequential reset operations. Ordinary SLSQP gives identical rational candidates/yield and Nelder-Mead is comparable. No unique solver advantage, hardware or total-cost superiority.
